snippet.title: Order: The New Dawn | Extended Early Access Trailer Is Here!
snippet.description:
Hi, everyone!

Order: The New Dawn will launch in Early Access on Steam on October 14 at 2:00 PM Beijing time (UTC+8).

Thank you for your patience and continued support! We look forward to meeting you in the United Star Systems and embarking on a new adventure together!

Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3080070/Order_The_New_Dawn/
